faqs.question: What's the difference between MPH and KPH?
faqs.answer: MPH (miles per hour) is used primarily in the US, while KPH (kilometers per hour) is used globally. 1 MPH equals approximately 1.609 KPH.

faqs.question: Why do some countries use different speed units?
faqs.answer: Speed units follow the measurement system used in each country. Metric countries use KPH, while countries using imperial measurements typically use MPH.

faqs.question: How accurate is GPS speed compared to speedometer?
faqs.answer: GPS speed is typically more accurate than speedometers, which often read 2-10% higher than actual speed due to tire wear, pressure, and calibration factors.

faqs.question: What speed unit do racing series use?
faqs.answer: It varies by series and location. Formula 1 uses KPH, NASCAR uses MPH, while marine racing often uses knots. Always check specific series regulations.
